cases.sentence: Иуда в то время оставил братьев и поселился у одного ___ из Эдулама по имени Хира.
cases.translation: At that time Judah left his brothers and settled near a certain man from Adullam named Hirah.
cases.explain: The preposition у governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Она забеременела и родила ___, которого назвали Ир.
cases.translation: She conceived and bore a son, who was named Er.
cases.explain: The transitive verb родить takes its animate direct object in the accusative, which equals the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Живи вдовой в ___ у твоего отца, пока не вырастет мой сын Шелла.
cases.translation: Live as a widow in your father's house until my son Shelah grows up.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Ир, Иудин первенец, был грешен в глазах Господа, и Господь предал его ___.
cases.translation: Er, Judah's firstborn, was wicked in the Lord's sight, and the Lord put him to death.
cases.explain: The fixed expression предать смерти (to put to death) takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Она сняла вдовьи одежды, покрылась ___, чтобы её не узнали.
cases.translation: She took off her widow's clothes, covered herself with a veil, so she would not be recognized.
cases.explain: The verb покрыться (to cover oneself with) takes the means in the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Я пошлю тебе ___ из моего стада.
cases.translation: I will send you a young goat from my flock.
cases.explain: The transitive verb послать takes its animate direct object in the accusative, which equals the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Твою печать на шнурке и посох, который у тебя в ___.
cases.translation: Your signet on a cord and the staff that is in your hand.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Иуда послал через своего друга козлёнка, чтобы получить назад залог у той ___.
cases.translation: Judah sent a young goat by his friend to get back the pledge from that woman.
cases.explain: The preposition у governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Там Иуда встретил дочь Хананея, которого звали Шуа.
reading.question: Whom did Judah meet in Adullam?
options: The daughter of a Canaanite named Shua
reading.correct: The daughter of a Canaanite named Shua
reading.explain: The text says Judah met 'дочь Хананея, которого звали Шуа' (the daughter of a Canaanite named Shua).

reading.ru: Но Ир, Иудин первенец, был грешен в глазах Господа, и Господь предал его смерти.
reading.question: What happened to Er, Judah's firstborn?
options: The Lord put him to death for his wickedness
reading.correct: The Lord put him to death for his wickedness
reading.explain: The text says Er was wicked and 'Господь предал его смерти' (the Lord put him to death).

reading.ru: Тогда Иуда сказал своей невестке Фамаре, «Живи вдовой в доме у твоего отца, пока не вырастет мой сын Шелла».
reading.question: What did Judah tell Tamar to do?
options: Live as a widow in her father's house
reading.correct: Live as a widow in her father's house
reading.explain: Judah tells her 'Живи вдовой в доме у твоего отца' (Live as a widow in your father's house).

reading.ru: Когда Иуда увидел ее, он принял ее за блудницу, потому что у нее было закрыто лицо.
reading.question: Why did Judah think Tamar was a prostitute?
reading.explain: The text says he mistook her 'потому что у нее было закрыто лицо' (because her face was covered).

reading.ru: Она ответила, «Твою печать на шнурке и посох, который у тебя в руке».
reading.question: What pledge did Tamar ask Judah for?
options: His signet on a cord and his staff
reading.correct: His signet on a cord and his staff
reading.explain: She asks for 'Твою печать на шнурке и посох' (your signet on a cord and your staff).

reading.ru: Иуда узнал их и сказал, «Она правее, чем я, потому что я не отдал ее за моего сына Шеллу, и он больше не ложился с ней».
reading.question: What did Judah admit when he recognized his pledge items?
options: That she was more righteous than he was
reading.correct: That she was more righteous than he was
reading.explain: Judah says 'Она правее, чем я' (She is more righteous than I) because he had withheld Shelah from her.
